headline: Rupiah Sore Ini Ditutup ke Level Rp18.235 per Dolar AS
summary: The rupiah closed at 18,235 per US dollar on Thursday, 19 November 2026, facing renewed pressure from the dollar. The currency had opened weaker at 18,225.
why: The rupiah is Indonesia's currency, and its level against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and foreign investor sentiment.
why_moved: The rupiah came under renewed pressure from the US dollar during the session, weakening further from its opening level.
